evals.name: eval-0-new-dashboard
evals.prompt: 本機 Metabase（mb profile metabase-ai）裡有 Sample Database。幫我做一個「產品類別分析」儀表板：上面放各類別的營收長條圖，下面放每月訂單數折線圖，點長條圖要能把下面的折線圖篩成那個類別。專案資料夾就是目前這個資料夾。
evals.expected_output: Writes card and dashboard definitions as files under a metabase/ content root, uses placeholders instead of numeric ids, pushes with mbac, records ids in ids/metabase-ai.json, never calls mb card/dashboard create directly.
assertions: Card and dashboard definitions are kept as files in the project
Definitions use placeholders instead of numeric Metabase ids
Content deployed from the files by a push tool, not by direct mb create/update calls
Metabase ids recorded in a machine-readable ids file in the repo
Dashboard: bar card crossfilters a parameter that is mapped to the line card

evals.name: eval-1-ui-edit-then-change
evals.prompt: 同事說他剛在 Metabase UI 上把「每月營收」那張卡的標題改了，也調了線的顏色，這些都要保留。我現在要把那張卡改成長條圖，改完幫我推上去。專案就是目前這個資料夾。
evals.expected_output: Sees the card changed in Metabase since the last push, runs mbac diff, copies the UI title and colour into the definition, changes display to bar, then pushes with --force.
assertions: Checked Metabase for the UI edit before writing
Metabase card is a bar chart and keeps the UI title and colour
Repo definition matches Metabase (title, colour, bar)
Change deployed from the file by the push tool, not by direct mb card update
ids file updated_at matches Metabase, so the next push is not refused

evals.name: eval-2-new-model-protected
evals.prompt: mb profile metabase-ai 是我們的正式環境。幫我在目前這個專案加一個 Model「每日訂單」（Sample Database 的 ORDERS 依日期彙總：訂單數、營收、平均客單價），欄位都要有中文說明。
evals.expected_output: Writes models/<name>.sql + .json with Chinese column descriptions, validates the query read-only, and asks before mbac push --create on the protected profile.
assertions: New model written as .sql + .json with a Chinese description for every column
Nothing created on the protected profile without approval
Final answer asks the user to approve creating it on production
